newsitem.title: MEXICO: TMM, APL start new train service.
newsitem.headline: TMM, APL start new train service.

text.p: Transportacion Maritima Mexicana (TMM) and APL Limited have begun a dual-level container railway shipping service from Mexico City to port city Manzanillo, the companies said in a statement on Tuesday.
The cargo route will run three days a week, leaving the port on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday and returning Thursday, Friday and Monday, the statement said.
"This new service, which consists of mounting one container on top of another, duplicates the route's capacity," it added.
TMM and APL announced last month they would join forces for container shipping between Mexico and Asia.
Manzanillo port is operated by a division of TMM, and is a key port for TMM's shipments to the Far East.
"This new service will boost trade between the Pacific nations and Mexico City," the statement said.
The route will provide "door to door transportation," it said, adding the service should ensure greater security against theft and improve transportation times.
The Manzanillo-Mexico City route is part of the Pacific-North line that Mexico is privatizing. The lone bidding consortium comprises Empresas ICA, Grupo Mexico and Union Pacific Corp..
